name: Durable Finance Claims v3 group ingress
type: AM Platform / Finance Claims / durable delivery
scope: Persist group-entry events before gateway delivery
Retry cold starts and transient failures with durable leases
Notify applicants only after terminal or exhausted failure
requiresEnv: Existing Finance Claims v3 gateway URL, token, and enable flag

dataIsolation.guard: Every queue transaction sets the tenant UUID and relies on forced PostgreSQL RLS; raw LINE source identifiers remain only in the tenant-scoped operational database and are never logged by this package.

changes: Add reusable processing-job enqueue, lease, and settlement operations
Add a separate five-second fast module scheduler
Queue exact Finance Claims v3 group commands before delivery
Use a 70-second downstream attempt plus bounded exponential retries
definitionOfDone: A sleeping downstream service no longer causes an immediate applicant error
Pending jobs survive AM process restarts and expired leases are recovered
Repeated webhook delivery cannot create duplicate jobs or group cards
Terminal identity failures remain private and no legacy form is created
The ordinary ten-minute module patrol cadence is unchanged
